To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pedagogical knowledge of the teacher is a major determinant of the quality of teaching and that teachers need to be aware of the characteristics of their pedagogical content.

the pedagogical knowledge of teachers is a major determinant of their classroom practices and that teachers' curriculum decision-making is influenced by their knowledge of the subject matter and their knowledge of how to teach that subject matter.

The seven characteristics of pedagogical knowledge that we identified in our classroom based research are: (a) the ability to make curriculum decisions, (b) the ability to plan for teaching, (c) the ability to teach, (d) the ability to assess, (e) the ability to reflect on teaching, (f) the ability to use technology in teaching, and (g) the ability to collaborate with others.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how teachers' pedagogic content knowledge can be developed.
understanding the development of teachers' pedagogic content knowledge in the teaching and learning of technology.
the development of a model of pedagogical content knowledge in technology education and how it can be used to enhance the effectiveness of technology teachers' curriculum decision-making.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the teacher's pedagogical content knowl- edge is the most important factor in the teaching process and that it has a direct effect on the quality of the learning experience for the students.
teachers' pedagogic content knowledge is a complex and dynamic construct that is influenced by the teacher's own experiences and the experiences of the learners.
pedagogical knowledge is a major determinant of teaching practice and curriculum decisions at the classroom level and that it is central to teachers professional development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
teachers' pedagogic content knowledge is an essential part of their professional development and that teachers' pedagogy is an essential component of the curriculum.
the more teachers know about teaching and the content they are teaching, the better they will be able to teach that content.
the development of pedagogical knowledge is a key component of teacher education and professional development.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the development of teachers' pedagogic content knowledge is a critical factor for effective teaching and that it is important for teachers to develop their own pedagogical content in order to be effective in their classroom.
pedagogical knowledge is an important factor in the development of teachers' knowledge and that this is a key factor to be considered in the development of effective teacher professional development.
pedagogical knowledge is a major factor in teachers' curriculum decisions at the classroom level.
